propositions: Documentation falsely claims the pypi environment rule enforces a second human approval when it actually requires only the configured release identity to approve their own run with self-review permitted
The runbook instructs operators to await an interactive GitHub UI prompt for pypi deployment approval when the actual mechanism is non-interactive REST API approval via pending_deployments endpoint
The pypi environment has prevent_self_review=false and can_admins_bypass=true, making the gate identity control over release job execution rather than independent code review
The approval process requires a properly typed JSON request body with environment_ids as an integer array, not string-typed field flags, to avoid 422 rejection by the API

The gate guarantees only that an identity on the required_reviewers list must approve the run; the 'source reviewed' property derives from Gerrit review on main, which the environment rule reinforces by controlling who can publish from that branch
